items.title: Wisdom of Nym: Reacting to Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold’s final reveals in Tokyo
Final Fantasy XIV Expansion Evercold Release Date Falls in February
items.summary: The Final Fantasy XIV Evercold expansion release date and Collector's Edition came up at the FFXIV Fan Fest 2026 held in Japan.
items.content:
Square Enix updated the release date for Final Fantasy XIV Evercold at the Japanese FFXIV Fan Festival and confirmed it will launch in February 2027. This comes after initial statements suggested we might see the add-on arrive in January 2027. Early access starts on February 19, 2027 for subscribers who get one of the collector’s editions. Everyone can start playing on February 23, 2027. Pre-orders open on November 4, 2026, according to the official site . We also now know the second new job is the Zephyr.

The Zephyr will be, as promised, a DPS to accompany the already revealed Bastion tank. They’re from Ilsabard. This will be a ranged unit that relies on a crossbow. However, it will also have a bird as a familiar to help with attacks. A new trailer went over what it will be capable of.

A Final Fantasy XIV Evercold full trailer appeared at the Tokyo FFXIV Fan Fest to accompany the release date reveal.

As for the Final Fantasy XIV Evercold Collector’s Edition options, you can get a digital FFXIV copy of physical one. The former is $64.99 and comes with the Crystal Skyltborg Shield for a Bastion, the Entreat Crystal emote, and a Valhallar Odin mount inspired by FFXIII . The latter is $319.99 and includes those three digital items, an Ethos metal keychain, a Kottr mini plush keychain, a Reaper figure, and a Tapestry of the Fourth.

Here’s a photo of the physical Collector’s Edition.

And there’s a trailer for the Valhallar Odin mount.

Final Fantasy XIV is out now on the Switch 2, PS4, PS5, Xbox Series X, and PC and the FFXIV Evercold expansion comes to every platform on February 23, 2027.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Evercold Delayed To Feb. 23, 2027 - Get All The New Details From Fan Fest Japan Including Zephyr, Fierce Raid & Split Alliance Raid
items.summary: New details on Final Fantasy XIV Evercold have emerged at Japan Fan Fest over the weekend, including a delay to February 23, 2027. Get all info here.
items.content:
Fresh details on Final Fantasy XIV Evercold have been revealed by Square Enix during Fan Fest Japan. We got a ton of details, both good and bad, that has some fans excited but also a little bit confused over some of the massive changes planned.

First off, Square Enix unveiled a full trailer; previously, the publisher broke down the trailer into three parts during each Fanfest, with the final one having This gives a tease to each location, but we got to see more of Visna and Baldr! Plus a character that is very familiar if you’ve been playing the game long enough.

The release date has been officially delayed until February (which for personal reasons is a bit of a shame!), but if the game needs more time to be worked on, then that’s understandable. The release date for Early Access is February 19, 2027, and the full launch is February 23, 2027. Preorders will open up on November 4, 2026.

The new physical job, which was teased in previous patches during Dawntrail, is the physical ranged job: Zephyr. Just like Bastion, which is the new double shield tank that was announced recently, this job will start at level 90 and can only be played in the new Evolved combat mode. You will need to visit Gridania to unlock the job. The job comes with a pet called Nephele, which is a bird that will do combos with you.

It’s also been revealed that you will be able to use the dye system to customize the colour of your Nephele, and it will have the two tone dye system, which will help make it feel more unique to you. I hope we get more custom options for Summoner in the future!

If you have kept up with the most recent MSQ, then we know that Alphinauld and Estinien will be joining us during Evercold. But also we learned more about Zephyr, Visna. From what we have experienced so far, she seems to be a community loved character.

The trailer also teased a new character called Baldr, who will be the Bastion tank job. I personally love his outfit, and he looks incredibly stylish. He is the leader of the realmship Hringhorni, which is the ship of fire. One major factor to consider: we arrived in this realm due to thinking of Ysayle, whom we lost a long time ago. In the trailer we saw a character named Lagertha, who also goes by the name Rime Blood, and has a striking similarity to Ysayle.

We also got to see new images of Halmarut and Calyx, who are already a key point of the story, especially with what seemed to be teased during the most recent patch about Halmarut, who may originally be from the 4th shard?

Elsewhere, we also got a ton of information on different realms; due to the story, mortals have moved over to the ships, as the planet itself is too harsh to live on. As such, they are split and on several different ships, and if you have seen the story, they are unable to visit other ships, so they are limited to the location they are born on.

Square Enix had already showcased Naglfar, Realmship of Water, and Hringhorni, Realmship of Fire at previous fanfests. This time, we got a preview of Sessrymnir, the Realmship of Earth. We caught a glimpse at exploring both above-ground areas and below-ground mining caves, which seemed to be filled with crystals. In addition, the development team also mentioned large, complex magic rituals. I do wonder if this is how the materials reappear, as it would be strange for a ship to basically have unlimited resources when it’s floating in the sky.

We also got to see Skiðblaðnir, the Realmship of Wind, which had the cute Kottr, and we got to see their lovely village. I can see this new allied society as a fan favorite, and I am hoping we will get an outfit based on them. Beyond that, fans got a look at Hjartadunur, which Yoshi P said after finishing MSQ you should make sure to check out every location.

Also, after complaints that the previous expansion, Jump Puzzles, was too easy, the development team confirmed they have added new Jump Puzzles that are even more challenging, including an ultimate jump challenge.

One of the key changes announced during Berlin Fanfest was that the story can be done in different ways; you will start at A, but you can do B/C/D (terms used as examples) in any way you want. Also, NPCs will have different dialogue based on your choice.

For the dungeons, enemies now feature the new Auto Content Balancing feature, so even if you are a higher level, they will be scaled up to you. This is different from the previous level sync feature, which would make you go back down to that level. This means you will have access to all your high-level skills.

items.title: Final Fantasy 14: Evercold sets itself a release date at the tail end of winter, alongside offering a look at its second, avian-inclined new job
items.summary: And it's coming slightly later than expected.
items.content:
Image credit: Square Enix News by Oisin Kuhnke Contributor Published on Nov. 1, 2026, 6:07 p.m. 1 comment Follow Final Fantasy XIV: A Realm Reborn - Collector's Edition Let's start with the bad news: Final Fantasy 14: Evercold has been delayed. The good news, that doesn't matter all that much, as it's only a delay of roughly a month, and a release date has been set in stone too: February 23rd, 2027. It's cutting it a bit close to the seasons shifting towards spring, making the game seasonally inappropriate, but hey ho, February is still winter!

That release date was revealed during this week's Final Fantasy 14 Fest Fest held in Tokyo. It was paired with a big ole cinematic that'll open up the expansion when you do actually get to play it. You can watch that down below if you fancy, that'll just depend on whether you want to go into the expansion knowing as little as possible. Looks pretty at least! I like the big dragony ship we've seen previously .

The expansion's second new job has been revealed too. It's called Zephyr, a physical ranged DPS that uses a crossbow and comes with its own avian familiar to assist you in battle. Seems like a pretty good option for folks afraid of getting in close but want to get some damage in. The bird friend you get is neat too. I hereby request that every other job gets a bird friend! I don't care if it doesn't make sense!

Most annoyingly, for me personally as someone that's only managed to play A Realm Reborn and doesn't really have time to go through a ridiculous number of hours and expansions just to get to this one, a preview for the Evangelion collab alliance raid was shown off rendered in the style of the original anime's post-credits, next episode teaser reels . I love those dang big robots and feelings of depression, don't make me go through all those expansions just to let my Viera dress up as Asuka or whatever loot you end up getting.

Anyway, don't forget to mark your calendars, February 23rd! Be there or be, uh, anywhere else I guess. I'm not your boss.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Evercold Delayed, New Release Date Announced at FFXIV Fan Fest
items.summary: The MMORPG's next expansion was set to launch shortly after the new year, but Warriors of Light will have to wait a bit longer.
items.content:
Final Fantasy XIV Evercold was set to launch sometime in January 2027, which was announced as part of its initial reveal back in April this year during the North American FFXIV Fan Fest. However, this next expansion for the critically acclaimed MMORPG has been delayed – FFXIV Evercold's release date is now February 23, 2027 (and February 19, 2027 for early access). This was announced alongside the new, full trailer / intro cinematic for Evercold at FFXIV Fan Fest in Japan, and was said to only be a four-week delay.

In typical FFXIV fashion, the third and final teaser trailer is the full opening cinematic for an expansion, and it kicked off the Japan Fan Fest keynote where director and producer Naoki Yoshida presented more details on new features, where the ongoing story is headed, and fundemental gameplay changes as FFXIV goes into version 8.0 alongside Evercold's launch.

Pre-orders for Evercold open on November 4, 2026 and will come with a Wind-up Kottr minion to summon and follow you around in the world and Halone's Earring which will boost the EXP you gain for Jobs under level 100 when equipped. The collector's edition comes with the Valhallar Odin mount, the Entreat Crystal emote, and the Crystal Skyltborg which looks like glam for the new Bastion Job's weapons. The physical collector's bundle has the Evercold art book, the Tapestry of the Fourth decoration, a Kottr plush, a keychain of the Ethos Metal, and the Warrior of Light Reaper figure.

Additionally, we got a glimpse of the second new Job coming to his new expansion. It's a ranged DPS called Zephyr, which rocks a crossbow as their primary weapon and commands an avian companion to provide support.

There's a lot coming to FFXIV Evercold in addition to a new world and main story including a Neon Genesis Evangelion crossover raid series (which got a new teaser trailer) , a Final Fantasy VII crossover raid series, a new Tank Job with Bastion, and much more. Be sure to check out my Dawntrail review as well to look back at the last expansion before heading into this new era for FFXIV.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Online's Sixth Expansion 'Evercold' Launches February 2027
items.summary: New job and much more revealed
items.content:
Now that the MMORPG Final Fantasy XIV Online is available on the Switch 2, Square Enix is looking towards the game's sixth expansion, Evercold .

We previously heard how it would be coming in January 2027, and now at the Final Fantasy XIV Fan Fest in Tokyo this weekend, Square Enix has announced the date has been shifted to 23rd February 2027 . Pre-orders will begin on 4th November 2026 , with early access opening on 19th February 2027 .

As previously confirmed, it will come with new jobs, cities, areas, dungeons, trials, new areas, a level cap increase and much more. Joining the Bastion job is the new physical ranged DPS, Zephyr. You can find out more about what's included in Evercold in our previous story and on the FFXIV YouTube channel .

* This event is identical to the one previously held. * Players who have already completed the quest during a previous event release may immediately resume playing the collaboration content. * After this collaboration event has ended, it will be held as a special event at irregular intervals. Visit the special site for more details.

Begin the quest "The Man in Black" by speaking to Kipih Jakkya in Ul’dah, Steps of Nald (X:8.5 Y:9.7). * Players must be level 50 and above to start the quest. * Players must have completed the main scenario quest “The Ultimate Weapon.”
